note: build_packages(brief, rows, today=16/09/2026) with default arguments, first saved BEFORE W04 split the loop into _gate and regenerated only for the changes listed in 'history'. 'subset' briefs run on colin_17sep_subset.json and are checked everywhere. 'full' outputs need the 17 Sep snapshot (matched by full_snapshot_fingerprint) and are checked only where SPB_SNAPSHOT_JSON points at it; they are stored as content_hashes plus a digest because the packages carry links. W11: regenerated for exactly two documented changes. Rows those packages used to carry past later gates move their counts too (stale_unverified, incomplete_facts, same_listing_collapsed, storey_unknown_and_binding, no_suburb).
